scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Scheduled Castes for Funeral Rites
other_conditions: The deceased must belong to the Scheduled Caste
The applicant must be a close relative of the deceased and also belong to the Scheduled Caste
The family must have nativity or at least three years of continuous residence in the Union Territory of Puducherry
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 for funeral rites.
